generate_openclaw_setup: generate an OpenClaw runtime config from environment variables and write config files to a home directory
resolve_provider_setup: resolve provider configuration from environment variables for anthropic, openai, google, openrouter, or openai-compat providers
build_openclaw_config: build the OpenClaw gateway and agent configuration dictionary from a resolved provider setup
build_openai_completions_provider: build an OpenAI-completions provider config dict with custom base URL, model, and context window settings
write_runtime_files: write OpenClaw runtime JSON config files and markdown identity files to the target home directory
